data.content_ref: inline:The failure of the panel in SRC_001 inherits the systemic vulnerability described in SRC_003, where the decomposition of a problem into linear steps (checklist) inherently excludes the non-linear integration required for expert intuition. This relation is refuted if a checklist-led panel can identify an edge-case anomaly (SRC_001) that requires the integration of non-linear variables (SRC_003).
